claims.claim: SGLang adaptive speculative decoding currently supports EAGLE/EAGLE3 with speculative_eagle_topk=1 and otherwise falls back to static settings.
Adaptive speculative policy tracks acceptance length with independent EMA slots for different batch-size ranges and uses candidate steps, warmup, update interval and hysteresis.
claims.locator: Per-batch tracking, runtime flow and policy decision

claims.claim: AdaptiveStepSlot computes an EMA from per-request accepted draft counts and updates candidate steps after warmup and configured intervals.
AdaptiveController prebuilds candidate SpecRuntimeState objects and switches the active state after batch routing or verification feedback.
BanditSpec formulates speculative decoding hyperparameter selection as online multi-armed bandit optimization.
Learning to Draft trains co-adaptive draft and verification policies to maximize draft-and-verify cycle throughput.
A larger candidate-step ladder can increase prebuilt runtime state and graph memory, so adaptive mode may not help stable workloads.
